tools.name: ping_jaeger
tools.description: Check connectivity to the Jaeger query service. Verifies whether the Jaeger UI / HTTP API is reachable and responding.

ping_url.description: Base URL of the Jaeger UI / Query service
ping_url.title: Ping Url

tools.name: get_all_services
tools.description: Retrieve the list of all instrumented service names available in Jaeger. Use this as the first step to discover active microservices.

ping_url.description: Base URL of the Jaeger UI / Query service
ping_url.title: Ping Url

tools.name: get_operations_for_service
tools.description: Retrieve all operations, endpoints, and span kinds (e.g., server, client, internal) registered for a specific service in Jaeger.

service_name.description: Name of the service to retrieve operations for (e.g. 'frontend')
service_name.title: Service Name

ping_url.description: Base URL of the Jaeger UI / Query service
ping_url.title: Ping Url

tools.name: get_trace_summaries
tools.description: Search and retrieve high-level trace summaries for a service within a time range from Jaeger.

service_name.description: Name of the service to query traces for
service_name.title: Service Name

start_time_min.description: Earliest start time in ISO-8601 format (e.g. '2026-10-08T12:00:00Z'). Defaults to 1 hour ago.
start_time_min.title: Start Time Min

start_time_max.description: Latest start time in ISO-8601 format (e.g. '2026-10-08T13:00:00Z'). Defaults to current time.
start_time_max.title: Start Time Max

search_depth.description: Maximum number of trace summaries to return
search_depth.title: Search Depth

operation_name.description: Optional operation name to filter traces within the service
operation_name.title: Operation Name

ping_url.description: Base URL of the Jaeger UI / Query service
ping_url.title: Ping Url

tools.name: get_trace_overview
tools.description: Get high-level overview and metrics for a specific trace, including wall-clock duration, span count, and service breakdown.

trace_id.description: Unique identifier of the trace to inspect
trace_id.title: Trace Id

ping_url.description: Base URL of the Jaeger UI / Query service
ping_url.title: Ping Url

tools.name: get_slowest_spans
tools.description: Identify latency bottlenecks by retrieving the slowest spans within a specific trace, sorted by duration descending with pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of slow spans to return per page
limit.title: Limit

ping_url.description: Base URL of the Jaeger UI / Query service
ping_url.title: Ping Url

tools.name: get_trace_errors
tools.description: Isolate and retrieve only the failing spans and exceptions/errors within a specific trace for rapid root-cause analysis.

trace_id.description: Unique identifier of the trace to inspect for errors
trace_id.title: Trace Id

ping_url.description: Base URL of the Jaeger UI / Query service
ping_url.title: Ping Url

tools.name: get_span_details
tools.description: Get granular details of a specific span within a trace, including exact timestamps, duration, attributes, events/logs, and child spans.

trace_id.description: Unique identifier of the trace containing the span
trace_id.title: Trace Id

span_id.description: Unique identifier of the specific span to inspect
span_id.title: Span Id

ping_url.description: Base URL of the Jaeger UI / Query service
ping_url.title: Ping Url
